description: Your Crop Will Grow Faster, Grow Bigger, Better Tasting & More Nutrious! Grow your very own delicious and plump strawberries with this Vertical Strawberry & Herb Gardening Grow bag Planter. Because the ingenious planter is upside down, gravity naturally causes the water and nutrients to pour directly and freely down from the root! You also don't need to have lots of room to grow your own strawberries or vegetables; this strawberry planter can be fixed to hang over your deck, patio or balcony. It's the simplest way to enjoy your own home-grown organic strawberries or a variety of other organically grown vegetables. Best of all the strawberry planter eliminates hours of back breaking labour weeding and caring for the plant. The strawberry planter has multiple ports to allow you to grow more then one at a time, it really is simple to use. Just plant the buds in the ports, fill it with soil and attach it to your desired growing spot on your patio or balcony. Everything is made easier, the swiveling top rotates making it easy to water your strawberries from the top, caring for the plant, you can't go wrong. It's new, it's innovative and it will have you eating your own fresh organic strawberries or vegetables in no time at all!
